content.text:
**In our app, no—we don’t select different Gradium models for push-to-talk and duplex.** The difference is how we handle audio:

- **Push-to-talk:** record your answer, then upload it for transcription.
- **Duplex/live:** continuously stream your microphone, detect pauses, and let you interrupt the reply.

Both use **Gradium transcription → Gemini response → Gradium speech**. Live transcription explicitly selects `default`; recorded transcription uses the API default. See [recorded mode](/Users/lambe/Developer/Graham/hackathon/src/lib/server/gradium.ts:80) and [live mode](/Users/lambe/Developer/Graham/hackathon/src/lib/duplex-session.ts:148).

So “duplex” here describes our conversation handling, rather than a separate speech-to-speech model. [Gradium’s model configuration docs](https://gradium.ai/content/how-to-use-json-config-gradium-tts-stt).
